How it works

From first episode to real listeners.

01

Make your episode

Record right in Pod+ or upload a file you made. Add a title and Pod+ makes a cover if you don't have one. No hosting plan, no setup.

02

Get put in front of listeners

New episodes go into Open Mic, where first-time and small creators come first. The strongest ones show up right inside For You.

03

Grow and earn

Go live with a LivePod, watch your numbers in Studio, and add a Pod+ Membership to start earning at your own prices from day one.

Questions

Creator FAQ

Does it cost anything to start a show?

No. Making an account, publishing episodes, going live and using Studio are all free.

Do I need special equipment?

No. You can record right in Pod+ with your phone or computer's microphone. If you already make episodes elsewhere, upload the audio file instead.

How do people find me?

Your episodes go into Open Mic, where new and small creators are put first, and strong new episodes also show up inside For You. Followers get a notification every time you post, and you can go live with a LivePod any time.

What can I see in Studio?

Plays, listeners, minutes listened and new followers day by day, where people found you, how much of each episode they finish, and how your LivePods went.

Can I make money?

Yes, starting soon. Any creator with a Pod+ Membership ($5 a month, the same plan listeners get) can earn from their first episode: supporter memberships, premium episodes and series, and Cheer payouts from LivePods. There are no follower, play or time minimums.

Why is there no minimum to start earning?

Many apps make you reach a follower or play count first. They do it to keep out spam and fake accounts, to avoid paying out lots of tiny amounts that cost more to send than they're worth, and to check who's getting paid for tax and fraud reasons. On Pod+, the membership does that job instead: it's a real account that's been verified and paid for, so every creator can earn from day one.

Do I set my own prices?

Yes. When creator earnings open, you choose your monthly supporter price and the price of any premium episode or series, and you decide which episodes stay free.
